purpose: Draft test-only strategy mapping that maps H1-H3 members to unitized weights, residuals, receipt state and no-fill states. It names no product, imposes no asset-class quota, sets no cash-income constraint and authorizes no action.

mapping_authorization_status.hard_gate: No formal replay or performance claim until authorization, source testing, R1/R2 review and independent risk approval.

open_universe_rule: Every qualifying onshore public instrument may be assessed under a frozen PIT rule. Every decision date still needs finite members and deterministic weights; this is not a fixed list or retrospective selection.

unitized_accounting.interpretation: Return-measurement convention only; not a cash-income objective or reinvestment instruction.
unitized_accounting.cost_rule: All costs are proportional and dated. Lots, minimum commissions and holder-specific tax conclusions are outside this mapping.

common_mapping_engine.volatility_input: annualised 63-session realised total-return volatility ending prior official close
common_mapping_engine.score_requirements: a_i must be positive and finite; zero, missing or invalid sigma_63 fails eligibility.
common_mapping_engine.initial_weight: w_i = a_i / sum(a_i) for active members
waterfall: reallocate excess pro rata by a_i to uncapped members

protected_liquidity_function.name: PL(t)
protected_liquidity_function.type: deterministic eligibility function, not a named holding
protected_liquidity_function.pass_rule: Record is classified within formal_scope; all required fields exist; return can be marked under strategy total-return convention; and issuer/guarantor cap is not breached.
protected_liquidity_function.unavailable_rule: Missing required field or no eligible record means PL(t)=unavailable; affected replay is invalid and no synthetic return is assigned.

receipt_state_rule.credit_rule: Credit net amount once to internal marked receipt state at actual payment/settlement timestamp.
receipt_state_rule.through_tested_oos_cohort: Nominal marked value through the tested OOS cohort, with no assumed interim return or automatic reinvestment.
receipt_state_rule.later_scheduled_decision: Draft mapping does not reassign receipt state. A different treatment requires a new frozen rulebook revision before testing.
receipt_state_rule.external_flow_boundary: External withdrawal is outside this test-only design and requires a separately documented TWRR subperiod break.

no_fill_exit_event_state.decision_to_target: Calculate after designated close; paper target no earlier than next permitted session.
no_fill_exit_event_state.rule: Prior marked state remains; unfilled difference stays residual or receipt state. No synthetic fill, substitute, stop exit or retrospective exit.
no_fill_exit_event_state.unsupported_actions: Rights, mergers, spin-offs, conversions, restructurings and unsupported actions block replay until source-tested adapters exist.

mappings.membership_mapping_consistency: Membership must require QVIM > 0 and top-decile rank; then a_i = QVIM_i / sigma_63,i. No non-positive-QVIM member reaches mapping.
mappings.B1: H1 base-eligible PIT universe before QVIM rank, a_i = 1 / sigma_63,i, identical caps/receipt/cost/PL(t).

mappings.membership_mapping_consistency: After frozen positive-surprise eligibility, a_i = positive_surprise_i / sigma_63,i.
mappings.B1: Same PIT base event universe and frozen active window without surprise rank, a_i = 1 / sigma_63,i, identical caps/receipt/cost/PL(t).
current_q0_reason: surprise dictionary and PIT consensus/publication archive unfrozen/unavailable

mappings.scope_change_rule: Another instrument class requires a new authorized data contract and frozen rulebook revision.
mappings.membership_mapping_consistency: After frozen strictly-positive 252-minus-21-session total-return eligibility, a_i = TR_(252_minus_21)_i / sigma_63,i.
mappings.B1: Same PIT base eligible universe with valid lookback but no trend filter, a_i = 1 / sigma_63,i, identical caps/receipt/cost/PL(t).
mappings.missing_lookthrough_rule: Missing required field means ineligible, not independent.

benchmarks.B0: 100% PL(t) functional comparator with identical receipt, valuation and proportional-cost rules; unavailable and not frozen.
benchmarks.B1: Hypothesis-specific matched comparator above; unavailable and not frozen.
